    n = len(grid)
    separators = [c for c in range(n) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(n))]
    edges = [-1] + separators + [n]
    spans = [(edges[k] + 1, edges[k + 1]) for k in range(len(edges) - 1)]
    spans = [(a, b) for a, b in spans if b > a]
    starts = [a for a, _ in spans]
    sizes = [b - a for a, b in spans]
    if not sizes or len(set(sizes)) != 1:
        raise ValueError("could not identify square tile layout")
    size = sizes[0]
    m = len(starts)
    motif_pos = next(((i, j) for i in range(m) for j in range(m)
                      if any(grid[starts[i] + r][starts[j] + c] == 2
                             for r in range(size) for c in range(size))), None)
    if motif_pos is None:
        raise ValueError("no motif found")
    mi, mj = motif_pos
    motif = [[grid[starts[mi] + r][starts[mj] + c] for c in range(size)]
             for r in range(size)]
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(min(m, size)):

            if motif[i][j] != 2:
